name: Watashi no Rakuen -Welcome to the Darkness-
original_name: 私の楽園－Welcome to the Darkness-
source:
Main heroine gets lost in the forest that's rumored to be the gates to the devil world. She makes a pact with a werewolf to protect her so that she can be eaten later on. It's up to the player whether she sets up on escaping and survival or falling in love during these seven days.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角在一片传说是魔界入口的森林中迷了路。她与狼人订立契约，让狼人保护自己，代价则是在事后被它吃掉。接下来的七天里，她究竟会设法逃亡、努力求生，还是渐渐坠入爱河，全由玩家决定。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
